Name: ZH's EBAGI
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/00UxMEi.png[/img][/center]

This EBAGI mod was made to be paired up with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods[/url] mod, adding EBAGI icons for all available artisan goods, which currently includes: Dried Mushrooms, Honey, Jelly, Juice, Pickles and Wine.

Whenever/If EBAGI updates to allow Aged Roe and Dried Fruits like in their plans, then they will be added. 

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RLMQOV9.png[/img]﻿[/center][b][u]ZH's EBAGI[/u][/b]
Contains all vegetables, fruits, honey and dried mushrooms, it however doesn't include forage items.

[b][u]ZH's EBAGI Plus[/u]
[/b]Contains [i]only[/i] the missing Juice and Pickles icons made from forage, these items aren't included in ZH's EBAGI juice and pickles. (For this specific pack, it only includes Cave Carrot, Chanterelle, Common Mushroom, Dandelion, Ginger, Hazelnut, Leek, Magma Cap, Morel, Purple Mushroom, Snow Yam, Spring Onion, Wild Horseradish, Winter Root)
[b] [/b]
These are made to be used together, so both can be downloaded and used, unless you do not want to include the extra, non-vegetable forage items for pickles and juice, then you can ignore the ZH's EBAGI plus file.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/GqSTJrq.png[/img][/center]
Until I figure out an easier way to change the styles around, this is currently how to change the styles. If a more experienced modder knows how I can do this, please feel free to let me know it would be a big help!

1. Inside the mod folder, there is both an Assets and All_Assets folder

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9JLbgZd.png[/img]
[b]Assets[/b] is what will[i] [/i][u][i]appear in game[/i]
[/u][b]All_Assets [/b]has all available options to choose from.

2. You need to replace the .png files in Assets folder with the ones that you want. Go through the All_Assets folder to find the pattern and colour you want to use.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mXuCG7e.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]﻿
3. [u][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/u] Make sure that the .png files you replace in the Assets folder have the correct file name. If you change the names in any way, then it will not work. The correct names are shown in the image above this point.

There is a full image guide inside the mod folder that shows a visual guide on how to change your style. Please refer to that if needed.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pcnCZXd.png[/img][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url].
3. Download the .zip file from this mod and install it

You're all done and ready to play.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pi5xeT0.png[/img]
